headword: {学業成就|がくぎょうじょうじゅ}
reading: がくぎょうじょうじゅ
gloss: academic success; fulfillment of one's studies

definitions.gloss: academic success; fulfillment of one's studies
definitions.explanation: The successful completion of one's studies or academic goals. A common wish printed on good-luck charms (お守り) sold at shrines and temples, typically for students.

examples.japanese: {学業成就|がくぎょうじょうじゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{守|まも}り→お守り：05955_omamori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a good-luck charm for academic success.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{学業成就|がくぎょうじょうじゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祈願|きがん}→祈願：13745_kigan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I prayed at the shrine for academic success.

examples.english: Wishing for my son's academic success, I visited Yushima Tenmangu shrine before his exams.

notes:
A four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) meaning literally "studies-achievement-fulfillment". Commonly seen on ⟦{絵馬|えま}→絵馬：05957_ema⟧ (votive tablets) and ⟦お{守|まも}り→お守り：05955_omamori⟧ at shrines associated with learning, especially those dedicated to Tenjin ({菅原道真|すがわらのみちざね}), the deity of learning.
